expect_edges.note: pyproject [project.scripts] `pytool = "pytool.cli:main"`: the module under the manifest dir's src/, then the attr
`pytool.cli:Sync.run`: each attr segment walks one child
setup.py console_scripts `setuptool = setuptool.app:run`, resolved from setup.py's directory
package.json bin map `./bin/jstool.js`: the script's MODULE
Cargo [[bin]] named like the package with no path: Cargo's default src/main.rs
Cargo [[bin]] rsextra with no path: Cargo's default src/bin/rsextra.rs

forbid.note: precision: only the attr the entry point names
precision: each bin key binds its own path
precision: the package-named bin is src/main.rs, not another bin's file

note: 0.5.6 GH.20: a binary a packaging manifest declares (pyproject scripts, setup.py console_scripts, npm bin, Cargo [[bin]]) HANDLED_BY the code its manifest names, drawn by resolver:host (rule manifest_bin) from the target the manifest extractor writes on the CLI_COMMAND. Before GH.20 each `cli:<bin>` had no edge: a manifest is a synthetic parse and refs never resolve across language graphs.
